textSample.target: // Key takeaways Edge Delivery and Document Authoring, end to end: what each piece actually does CDN and edge workers in front of EDS - where the seams are Authenticating DA and wiring it to GitHub Block-aware bulk search and replace across a content tree, without scripting What we covered Two sessions. The first walked the building blocks of a modern Edge Delivery / Document Authoring site - how EDS, DA, the CDN layer and AEM Cloud backends fit together, and which customisations are worth making. The second demonstrated safe bulk content updates in EDS/DA: finding content by block and property across a whole tree, versioning before changing anything, and undoing a bulk edit that went wrong. Watch the session https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=87PyVSF3Enc
